subject: core's channel handling for H3 reference audio
why: The retired gate asserted a mono reference raises. It verified that by hand-building a 1-channel latent and reproducing PackedLayout's assignment, which does fail -- but core upmixes mono to stereo in comfy.sd.VAE.encode before the model is reached, so no 1-channel latent occurs on the real path. The gate traced comfy/ldm/minimax/audio_vae.py and stopped one wrapper short of the call _encode_ref_audio actually makes.
